dialogues.jp: 確か、杉並が言っていた。
dialogues.en: The housewife shoppers are gathering around the fish store.
dialogues.text: The housewife shoppers are gathering around the fish store.

dialogues.jp: 烏は神の使いだ――と。

勿論そんな言葉を信じたわけではないが、意味
ありげにこっちを見ていた烏を追いかけている
内に、神社にたどり着いてしまった……。
dialogues.en:
"Don't miss this! I'm selling 100g chicken thighs for 50
yen!"
dialogues.text:
"Don't miss this! I'm selling 100g chicken thighs for 50
yen!"

dialogues.jp: ひょっとして、これはひょっとするのか？
dialogues.en:
The meat shop started promoting their sale in response to
the fish shop sale. Now the housewife shoppers were moving
to the meat shop.
dialogues.text:
The meat shop started promoting their sale in response to
the fish shop sale. Now the housewife shoppers were moving
to the meat shop.

dialogues.jp:
烏はそのまま、境内で｛ひときわ／一際｝立派な様相の神木に
羽を降ろす。
dialogues.en: (The customers are so honest.)
dialogues.text: (The customers are so honest.)

dialogues.jp: ますます高まる期待。
dialogues.en: The customers returned to the fish store again.
dialogues.text: The customers returned to the fish store again.

dialogues.jp: まさか、あの神木の裏から神様が出てくるとか？
dialogues.en: The customers went back to the meat shop again.
dialogues.text: The customers went back to the meat shop again.

dialogues.jp: まさか、なぁ……。
dialogues.en: (What a battle.)
dialogues.text: (What a battle.)

dialogues.jp:
はやる気持ちを抑えて、ゆっくりと、ゆっくり
と近付いていく。
dialogues.en: They were watching each other tensely.
dialogues.text: They were watching each other tensely.

dialogues.jp:
一歩を踏み出す動作と心臓の鼓動がリンクして
いるかのような高揚感――。
dialogues.en: The fish store manager was biting his lip.
dialogues.text: The fish store manager was biting his lip.

dialogues.jp: もう少し……。
dialogues.en: Is that it?
dialogues.text: Is that it?

dialogues.jp: あと一歩……。
dialogues.en: "Keiichi! Come here for a second."
dialogues.text: "Keiichi! Come here for a second."

dialogues.jp: 届いた！
dialogues.en: The fish store manager had called someone from inside.
dialogues.text: The fish store manager had called someone from inside.

dialogues.jp: ちりん。
dialogues.en: The back door opened and 'a very good looking' guy appeared.
dialogues.text: The back door opened and 'a very good looking' guy appeared.

dialogues.jp:
期待を込めて神木の裏を覗き込んだ俺の目に飛
び込んできたのは……。
dialogues.en: The guy came over to help the manager.
dialogues.text: The guy came over to help the manager.

dialogues.jp:
いまだに生物として認めるのを｛ためら／躊躇｝ってしまう
白い物体……うたまる、だった。
dialogues.en: At that moment -- all the old ladies came over.
dialogues.text: At that moment -- all the old ladies came over.

dialogues.jp: 「まさか……な」

いかにも何も考えていなそうな黄色い目と視線
がぶつかる。
dialogues.en: That's it.
dialogues.text: That's it.

dialogues.jp: 「ははは……ありえない、って」
dialogues.en: How easy to understand......
dialogues.text: How easy to understand......

dialogues.jp: 「なぁ？」
dialogues.en:
I watched the battle to the very end, then began walking
again listening to the butcher murmur.
dialogues.text:
I watched the battle to the very end, then began walking
again listening to the butcher murmur.

dialogues.jp:
うたまるは俺の問いかけに答えることなく、も
う一度鈴の音を鳴らして、森の奥へと去っていっ
た……。
「かったるい……ということに、しておこう」
dialogues.en: Why aren't the old men coming!?
dialogues.text: Why aren't the old men coming!?

dialogues.jp: ◆うたまる神？◆
dialogues.en: ◆Fish store manager◆
dialogues.text: ◆Fish store manager◆

dialogues.jp:
導くような烏の後を追いかけた俺は神社にたど
り着いた。
dialogues.en: He was quite loud. The promenade was as lively as usual.
dialogues.text: He was quite loud. The promenade was as lively as usual.

dialogues.jp: 烏の止まった神木の裏で俺が見たものは……。。
dialogues.en: (No point for us, we never cook at home......)
dialogues.text: (No point for us, we never cook at home......)

dialogues.jp: うたまるだった……。
dialogues.en: We could save so much money if we did.
dialogues.text: We could save so much money if we did.
